title.narrative: The third extension of the contract for the management, guarding and cleaning of the refugee camp (the housing units project in Abkhaz Governorate in the Republic of Djibouti (300) housing units, public facilities and a school for refugees) for the year 2023 .

description.narrative: The National Office for the Relief of Refugees and Affected Persons in Djibouti (ONARS) has established mechanisms to house and supervise Yemeni refugees in the camp in Abkhaz Governorate in the Republic of Djibouti, operate the school and public facilities in cooperation with Djiboutian government agencies, provide the necessary quantities of water to Yemeni refugees, and protect and manage the camp facilities and its residents.

The National Office for the Relief of Refugees and Affected Persons in Djibouti (ONARS) is developing a mechanism to accommodate and supervise Yemeni refugees in the camp, operate the school and public facilities in cooperation with Djiboutian government agencies, provide the necessary quantities of water to the refugees, and protect and manage the camp and its residents.
Yemeni refugees have access to safe and clean water, education, fair distribution of housing units, and camp management.
